conventions.forward: +Z (character faces +Z; its LEFT is +X, its RIGHT is -X)
conventions.rest_pose: A-pose (arms ~45 deg below horizontal), standing, feet on y=0
conventions.joint_rest_rotation: IDENTITY for every joint (and unit scale): joint local axes == character axes in bind pose. Animation tracks are therefore plain character-space rotations; procedural offsets (aim pitch, lean, look-at) can be applied as rotations about +X (pitch, positive = nose down), +Y (yaw, positive = turn left), +Z (roll).
conventions.animation_tracks: quaternion rotation tracks for joints + ONE position track on Hips (absolute, meters, in Armature space). No scale tracks. 30 fps, linear.
conventions.binding: clips bind by node name: new AnimationMixer(characterScene).clipAction(clip) works for every variant (anims GLBs contain only the skeleton nodes).

skeleton.naming: Mixamo-style, no prefix (Hips, Spine, Spine1, Spine2, Neck, Head, LeftShoulder, LeftArm, LeftForeArm, LeftHand, LeftHand{Thumb,Index,Middle,Ring,Pinky}{1..3}, LeftUpLeg, LeftLeg, LeftFoot, LeftToeBase, LeftToe_End, HeadTop_End, Right*)

sockets.name: socket_weapon_r
sockets.description: Child node of RightHand. Attach weapon GLBs here unchanged (weapon convention: origin = firing-hand grip, barrel +Z, up +Y). Derived from the rifle aim pose (barrel from right grip to left grip); also correct for pistols in the shipped pistol clips. In rifle_aim / pistol_aim / *_crouch_aim / *_prone_aim / *_fire the barrel points exactly along character +Z and level.

sockets.name: socket_weapon_l
sockets.description: Child node of LeftHand, mirror of socket_weapon_r (for left-hand items: grenade before throw, melee weapons held left).

sockets.name: socket_support_l
sockets.description: Child node of LeftHand at the left palm centre (identity orientation). Use as the IK end-effector: drive the left arm so this point reaches the weapon's grip_support node. In rifle_aim the support point sits ~0.35 m along the barrel from the right grip; in the low-ready rifle clips ~0.43 m.

lod: Each variant has <id>.glb (LOD0) and <id>_lod1.glb (LOD1, same skeleton, same UV layout, 512 px textures). LOD1 can also re-use the LOD0 materials to share GPU textures.
materials: body / head (opaque, PBR: baseColor + tangent-space normal (OpenGL) + ORM [R=1, G=roughness, B=metal=0]) and optional hair/helmet/equipment; "hair" is alpha-tested (alphaMode MASK, cutoff 0.45, double-sided, WebP RGBA). EXT_texture_webp + EXT_meshopt_compression + KHR_mesh_quantization are used (GLTFLoader needs setMeshoptDecoder).

anims.note: Clip table for /assets/anims/*.glb (same content as /assets/anims/manifest.json). move_dir = [right, forward] in character space. speed_mps = ground speed of the ORIGINAL root motion (in-place clips): playback timeScale = actual_speed / speed_mps keeps feet planted.
